import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=None)

# Find header row
header_idx = None
for i in range(len(df_raw)):
    if df_raw.iloc[i,0] == 'Invoice ID' and df_raw.iloc[i,1] == 'Expense Date':
        header_idx = i
        break
print("header_idx", header_idx)

# Get column names from header row
cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
print("cols", cols)

# Data starts after header
data = df_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
data.columns = cols

# Rename first column to Invoice ID for clarity
# Let's inspect first few rows
print(data.head(30))

# Filter rows where Invoice ID looks like SEVA-... pattern
invoice_pattern = re.compile(r'^SEVA-\d{2}-\d{4}$')
mask_valid_invoice = data['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.match(invoice_pattern)

# Also ensure Funding Type is exactly 'Government Scheme'
mask_funding = data['Funding Type'] == 'Government Scheme'

filtered = data[mask_valid_invoice & mask_funding]

print("Filtered rows count:", len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Invoice ID','Funding Type','Programme']].head(20))

distinct_ids = filtered['Invoice ID'].nunique()
print("Distinct IDs:", distinct_ids)
print("IDs list:", filtered['Invoice ID'].unique().tolist())

import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=None)

header_idx = None
for i in range(len(df_raw)):
    if df_raw.iloc[i,0] == 'Invoice ID' and df_raw.iloc[i,1] == 'Expense Date':
        header_idx = i
        break

cols = df_raw.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data = df_raw.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
data.columns = cols

invoice_pattern = re.compile(r'^SEVA-\d{2}-\d{4}$')
mask_valid_invoice = data['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.match(invoice_pattern)

# Also drop rows where Funding Type is NaN
filtered = data[mask_valid_invoice & (data['Funding Type'] == 'Government Scheme')]

print("Total valid invoice rows:", mask_valid_invoice.sum())
print("Rows with Funding Type Government Scheme:", filtered.shape[0])
print("Distinct invoice IDs:", filtered['Invoice ID'].nunique())
print(filtered['Invoice ID'].tolist())

# Check for any duplicate IDs
dup = filtered['Invoice ID'].value_counts()
print("Duplicates:", dup[dup>1].to_dict())
